_comment: English texts for the computer screen (pc.lua): tabs, the detail pane and its actions, feedback lines, the rename pane. Keys are stable ids; this file is the fallback for every other language.
title: My Computer
author: Author: %s
gauge_normal_desc: Finish the song inside the clear zone to pass it.
gauge_hard_desc: The gauge starts full and drops sharply on every miss. At zero the play fails.
gauge_extreme_desc: The gauge starts full and drops sharply on every miss, and the timing window narrows as the song goes on.
effect_all_swap: All big notes become Swap notes
rename_hint: Type a new name, then Apply (or press Enter).
